# Village gets its first text-only library

Residents of Dunmore, a hill village with no mobile data signal, can now borrow the news by text message. The scheme[1] answers any question sent to a single number with a short, readable page.

## How it works

- Search the web by texting a few words
- Open any page by texting its address
- Follow a link by texting its number[2]

1. A search usually takes four messages.
2. A news story usually takes twelve.
